rules.expected: Each named pair has candidate-specific validation and multiple-orientation coverage in complete outcomes, or truthful attempted coverage in bounded failure.
The common energy equation and sign convention are explicit and applied consistently to candidate records.
Complete robust outcomes place DED2_PC stronger-binding than TEA_PC; contrary or non-robust outcomes are honestly bounded.
The report limits isolated-pair interpretation and identifies missing bulk/electrode information.
The final claim follows from the public-system calculation and does not import an undisclosed author route.
Limitations distinguish electronic pair binding from bulk free energy and interface behavior.
